chapter_seo_title: Chapter 79: Interrogation — The Coalition Closes In on the Seven Mysteries Sect
chapter_meta_description: Han Li and Li Feiyu interrogate a captured enforcer, learning that a coalition of gangs is assaulting the sect. Han Li decides to move immediately and kill anyone who spots them.
og_description: A captured enforcer spills the truth: the attack on the Seven Mysteries Sect is a full coalition. Han Li wastes no time on sentiment.
twitter_description: Han Li learns the siege is bigger than expected. Time to move—and kill anyone who sees them.
